input: Set up a tip jar on my music streaming profile

gold.taskTitle: Set up a tip jar on music streaming profile
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to add a tipping feature to their music streaming profile so listeners can financially support them directly.

questions.title: Which streaming platform is your music profile on?
questions.description: Identify the specific platform (e.g., Spotify, SoundCloud, Bandcamp, YouTube Music) where the tip jar needs to be set up.

questions.title: Which tip jar service do you want to use?
questions.description: Determine the preferred tipping platform such as Ko-fi, Buy Me a Coffee, PayPal, Venmo, or Patreon.

questions.title: Do you already have an account on a tipping platform?
questions.description: Find out if the user has an existing account set up on their chosen tip jar service or needs to create one from scratch.

questions.title: What payment methods do you want to accept from fans?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants to accept credit cards, PayPal, crypto, or other specific payment methods through the tip jar.

questions.title: Do you want a fixed tip amount or open amount?
questions.description: Determine if the user prefers preset tip amounts, a custom open-entry field, or both options for supporters.

questions.title: Where exactly on your profile should the tip jar appear?
questions.description: Identify the specific placement such as bio section, link in profile, pinned post, or a dedicated link page like Linktree.

questions.title: Do you want a personal message or goal shown with the tip jar?
questions.description: Find out if the user wants to display a funding goal, a thank-you message, or a specific reason for asking for tips.
